name: Journey Back Home
source:
You wake up alone in a cabin with no memories. Equipped with a flashlight, a map, and a bunch of strange magical candy canes, you set out on a snow-filled journey to get your memories back. Whoever you meet can be a friend, or a foe, depending on your choices.

Can you survive the journey and remember who you are?

[From [url=https://ruo-ze.itch.io/journey-back-home]itch.io[/url]]
